name: Elias Merhy
quote: Danial possesses very sharp technical knowledge in AI/ML and backend technologies. What sets him apart is his readiness to take on any challenge, his curiosity, and a calm approach that lets him understand a project's full context before proposing the right solution.

name: Ricardo Lamego
quote: Danial's real strength was turning abstract ideas into working systems fast. I could throw anything at him and trust he'd deliver — not perfection, but 80–90% solutions fast enough to keep us moving.

name: Maggie Chao
quote: His breadth is remarkable — machine learning, production engineering, computational design. He can design high-level solutions and fix nitty-gritty details. Any employer would be lucky to have him.
